title: Case-only duplicate manifest entries are caught at BUILD time
question_or_target: Do two package entries differing only in case get rejected when the package is built, rather than colliding on the user's case-insensitive filesystem at install time? PASS requires the build to fail with both paths named.

evidence.claim: Independent reviewer verified the artifact at command-center/receipts/TST-0194.json exists on disk (31257 LF-normalized bytes), parses as JSON, carried the builder terminal state=BLOCKED with failure.classification=[reviewer-absent] and reviewer=null (no self-certification) at review time, and its report.kind=portability_report matches the catalog output_schema pin.

probes.raw_output: parsed OK; builder state=BLOCKED; classification=[reviewer-absent]; reviewer=null

evidence.claim: Independent reviewer re-ran both named probes live for 3 rounds each under the ambient environment; all exited 0 with the unit SUCCESS sentinel (probe1_build_rejects.py=3/3 rounds rc0; probe2_install_deferral.py=3/3 rounds rc0); live sentinels match the builder-recorded raw_output lines (consistent=True).

probes.raw_output: SUCCESS:TST-0194-probe1 build_rejects=True both_named=True distinct_builds=True | SUCCESS:TST-0194-probe2 installed=1<2 silent-loss-demonstrated=True

probes.command: compare live SUCCESS sentinel lines against SUBAGENT-RETURN.json named_probes[].raw_output

evidence.claim: UNIT-ARTIFACT-MANIFEST.json registered command-center/receipts/TST-0194.json with a sha256 row matching the live artifact (CRLF normalized to LF before hashing; program digest mode sha256+length over LF-normalized bytes). Reviewer recomputed the digest independently.

The closure receipt validates against BOTH the program gate (platform/schema/receipt.schema.json $defs/receipt_core, 0 errors) and the catalog output_schema pointer (command-center/schema/receipt.schema.json#/$defs/portability_report, 0 errors via the platform schema resolver), and the 12-condition completion predicate evaluates COMPLETE with filesystem verification on.

probes.raw_output: admission ACCEPT on the closure and REJECT naming the reviewer rule on the independent-flipped mutation copy

reviewer.notes: Wave-3 shard-22 independent reviewer closure. Reviewer did not build this unit; re-derived every contract check live in a fresh context: artifact predicate on the builder BLOCKED pointer, both named probes re-run for 3 stability rounds each (all exit 0, SUCCESS sentinels match the builder record), manifest sha256 recomputed (CRLF-to-LF digest mode), receipt_core + catalog output_schema validation, 12-condition predicate COMPLETE, and a reviewer mutation control (receipt_core must reject a copy whose reviewer.independent is false). Catalog reviewer_requirement (second Windows shell) re-executed by the reviewer: every probe run under pwsh7 AND Git Bash, exit 0 on both lanes, sha-normalized outputs identical. Receipt rewritten from the builder BLOCKED pointer into receipt-core shape; the original builder document is preserved verbatim under extensions.builder_receipt_original. The receipt self-row is role=supporting and carries the PRE-closure builder bytes sha256; the authoritative post-closure registration is the UNIT-ARTIFACT-MANIFEST row, refreshed by the reviewer to the final closure bytes (see extensions.reviewer_manifest_refresh).
